title: A resistance level just above the entry
why: Item 6 of 3.10, the data side. The sensors are those of scenario 04, with one support and resistance level (sr_3) 1.30 above the M5 baseline. For a LONG at the baseline zone that level is the next opposing level, so the zone's runway is 1.30 and its runway ratio is tiny; the level also falls inside the zone, so the zone gains a confluence level and ranks first. Section 6 (build step 5) is what blocks targets beyond it; this scenario pins the numbers it will read.
